config.py:768-772 sets env_prefix=SQLLENS_ and env_nested_delimiter=__ on Config. config.py:811 puts env_settings in the sources. SQLLENS_LLM__TEMPERATURE is therefore exploded into {'llm': {'temperature': '...'}}. This follows pydantic-settings' explode_env_vars, which keeps unknown nested keys and doesn't filter them against the sub-model's fields. That is from my knowledge of the library, not something I read in its source here. Config.llm is a plain LLMConfig field. LLMConfig's mode='before' validator (config.py:173-178) receives that dict and raises when 'temperature' is in it, the same check TOML keys hit. LLMConfig has no extra='forbid', so without the guard the key would be ignored silently. tests/unit/test_llm_sampling_options.py:219-224 covers the env-only case, with the env var set and a TOML file without temperature, and expects rejection. I did not run it.

LLMConfig (src/sqllens/config.py:139) is a plain BaseModel with no model_config, so pydantic's default extra='ignore' applies. Falsifying input: an [llm] table containing an unknown key such as temperature. Without the before-validator at 173-178, the key would be dropped silently. The top-level Config extra='forbid' (771) does not propagate to nested models, as the comments at 285 and 491 also say. The guard at 176 raises on 'temperature', so the comment is accurate.
